# `mise bootstrap packages import`

- **用法：** `mise bootstrap packages import [FLAGS]`
- **效果：** 修改状态
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/system/import.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/system/import.rs)

Record installed Homebrew formulae in `[bootstrap.packages]`

Adds a `brew:` entry for each linked formula you installed yourself,
skipping formulae that were installed only as dependencies; `--all`
includes those too. Formulae from third-party taps are written with their
full name, and each tap gets a `[bootstrap.brew.taps]` entry with the URL
already in your config or the default GitHub URL. Writes the local config
unless you pass `-g`, `-e`, or `-p`.

## Flags
- **`-e --env <ENV>`** — Write to the config file for this environment (mise.&lt;ENV>.toml)
- **`-g --global`** — Write to the global config (~/.config/mise/config.toml)

  New entries go to the `write_targets.packages` file when that setting is set.
- **`-m --manager <MANAGER>`** — Package manager to import from

  **选项：** `brew`

  **Default:** `brew`
- **`--all`** — Import every linked formula, including dependencies
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Show the entries that would be written without writing them
- **`-p --path <PATH>`** — Write to this config file or directory

  **别名：** `--file`
- **`-h --help`** — 打印帮助

## 示例

Show the entries that would be written

```
mise bootstrap packages import --dry-run
```

Write them to the local config

```
mise bootstrap packages import
```

Include formulae installed as dependencies

```
mise bootstrap packages import --all
```

Write to the global config

```
mise bootstrap packages import -g
```
